name: Pulsestart Nursing and Midwifery Bursary
summary: Up to $2,500 for full-time Griffith nursing and midwifery students facing educational disadvantage.
key: Maximum value is $2,500, payable in a single instalment.
who: Bachelor of Nursing or Bachelor of Midwifery student who has completed at least 40 CP.
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
catches: The 2026 round closed 17 August 2026. Griffith lists applications opening 1 July 2027 for Trimester 2, 2027.
